architecture.summary: The Render service of a tenant from hosted signup gets the organization name in its name (owner request of 2 November 2026): the signup route of web gives the organization name of its form to the tenant request through the signup port that app composes, TenantRequests of tenants stores it in the new nullable column organization_name of thermus_admin.tenants (migration 20261102161257_tenant_organization_name.sql, applied before the deploy), and the claim of the provisioner names the service <prefix><organization slug>-<organization ID slug>, for example thermus-tenant-acme-corp-org-01m6asdn5ykzsy19rqen97ndh3; a row without a name or with an empty slug keeps the name of today, so existing rows, services, the prefix filter of the fleet script, and the orphan runbook stay valid. The requests of the gateway, of the workspace status read, and of the fleet script store no name. The data contract of the tenants table changes (contract, deployment: the migration order), the signup port of web and the store contracts of tenants gain the organization name (internalInterface), and the registry and Render now hold a copy of the organization name of WorkOS, which a deleted row keeps. No component, container, public module, dependency, or Mermaid view changes; the prose of the tenant registry view and of the recorded hosted Render target records the rule.
